capabilities: Collect highlights into sidebar note cards
Filter cards by color, keyword and tag
Highlight and annotate PDF and EPUB files
disambiguation: Not a general PDF or EPUB annotation suite; it is a highlight card manager that also reads PDFs and epubs.
extras: Cross-device sync goes through a vault file (.hilighter/sync-data.json) with add/update-only merges and 30-day tombstones; it does not read Obsidian Sync conflicted copies. EPUB reading requires enabling "Detect all file extensions". An optional pandora-hilight agent skill (ZCode, Claude Code) can auto-highlight a whole document. README is bilingual English/Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect, filter and revisit highlighted passages across Markdown, PDF and EPUB files.

requires.name: AI provider (DeepSeek, Google Gemini, Volcano Engine Ark)

summary: Highlight note manager that turns Markdown, PDF and EPUB highlights into note cards with AI chat, mind maps and FSRS review.
